h: King Mitchy claims Burna Boy never paid VeryDarkMan's N250m, says a school was built with NGO funds
p: Nollywood-linked personality King Mitchy has reportedly claimed that Burna Boy never paid the N250 million once linked to VeryDarkMan, and that a school was instead built using funds from a non-governmental organisation. The claim is said to be his own and has not been confirmed by either camp.
more: The money was the subject of heated online debate earlier.
Neither Burna Boy nor VeryDarkMan has publicly responded to the claim.
